limitations: One board per chip, one AP and room-temperature conditions; no calibrated RF measurement or long-duration reliability claim.
TX IQ measurement and attenuation search replaced on both chips. Fourteen other TX calibration routines, analog callbacks and ROM dependencies remain; RX archive members stay absent.
Original-instruction oracle compares ordered modeled boundary behavior; it does not prove cycle timing, RF or analog equivalence.
Prior packet gaps and latency tails remain open. All current trial outcomes are retained without retry or relabeling.
AP Ethernet captures corroborate EAPOL exchanges but are not complete independent RF captures.

timing_observations.limits: Cumulative metrics cannot correlate a particular packet with an operation. Group losses in the comparison are preserved separately. No cycle-equivalence or packet-loss fix is claimed.

final_board_state.esp32c3: ordinary source image retained; terminal outcome recorded in restoration result
final_board_state.esp32s3: held in ROM by paired flasher; ordinary source app retained

validation_notes: Actual emitted TX IQ instructions and constants checked in all eight source application profiles: 13,232 case executions, full native PC and conditional-edge coverage.

Ordered register reads/writes, output halfwords, signed arithmetic, chip-specific entry narrowing, six-sample limit and fresh C3 callback dispatch match the original modeled boundary traces. Analog effects remain outside the model.
All retained TX input names/sizes are compared against control. Selected IQ inputs disappear; fourteen other TX bodies per chip retain vendor ownership. RX archive members remain absent.
Images are bound to implementation/control commits by recorded source hashes and exact Cargo locks. Example code is identical; TX probe remains disabled on both sides.
Local Cargo repro tests use installed Rust 1.91.0; serial tests use ESP-IDF Python with pyserial 3.5. Default toolchains and locks are unchanged.
